rules: ACTIVE sources are the connectors already on this desk. PROPOSED sources were brought in by Claude on 2026-09-30 at the operator's request; each records what was checked and on which page.
Nothing PROPOSED is used until the operator approves it: bin/sentinel-cycle library approve ID --by NAME.
authoritative=false means an aggregator, mirror or index. Its rows are leads; the publisher's own record is the source.
Individuals who appear in any source (donors, parties, excluded persons, defendants who are not officials) are counted, never named.
An address is not a person. A label from any index is UNVERIFIED until separate evidence ties it to someone.

sources.name: OpenSanctions API
sources.holds: Sanctions, watch-list and politically exposed entities gathered from many official lists.
sources.cannot_show: A name match is not an identity match. The official list (for US designations, OFAC) is the primary source; see SRC-OFAC-SLS.

sources.name: CourtListener REST API v4
sources.publisher: Free Law Project (mirror of court records)
sources.limits: The desk budgets 125 calls a day. Sweeps use --new-only.
sources.holds: Opinions, dockets, parties and RECAP filings.
sources.cannot_show: A docket entry is a filing, not a finding. Party lists name private people: count them, cite by docket number.

sources.name: Federal Register API v1
sources.note: The human docs page redirected a script to an unblock page on 2026-09-30; the API itself answered, so the API is probed.
sources.holds: Rules, proposed rules, notices and presidential documents, with document numbers.
sources.cannot_show: Anything decided before or outside publication.

sources.name: OpenFEC API
sources.holds: Committees, filings, receipts, disbursements and independent expenditures.
sources.cannot_show: Money kinds are not interchangeable: an independent expenditure is not a gift, a transfer is not a contribution. The ledger never sums across kinds.

sources.name: Lobbying Disclosure API
sources.holds: LD-1 registrations, LD-2 activity reports (clients, issues, bills, income/expenses) and LD-203 contribution reports.
sources.cannot_show: A bill listed on a filing was lobbied on; that is not evidence the lobbying changed it.

sources.name: Regulations.gov API v4
sources.holds: Rulemaking dockets, documents and public comments.
sources.cannot_show: A comment is what a commenter said. Comment volume is not public opinion.

sources.name: BLS Public Data API
sources.note: Its developer page answered a generic script with 403 on 2026-09-30. `bin/sentinel connect test` checks the connector itself.
sources.holds: Statistical series, queried by series identifier, not by name.

sources.name: OpenCorporates API v0.4
sources.holds: Company registrations by jurisdiction and number.
sources.cannot_show: Who owns or controls a company. The state registry record is the source; two companies with similar names are two nodes until a number matches.

sources.name: USAspending API v2
sources.holds: Federal contract and assistance awards, obligations and recipients.
sources.cannot_show: An award ceiling is not cash paid. Obligations are not outlays.

sources.name: Consumer Complaint Database API
sources.holds: Consumer complaints and company responses.
sources.cannot_show: A complaint is what a consumer said, not a verified fact, and the data has no denominator.

sources.name: SEC EDGAR APIs
sources.note: SEC answers a generic script with 403; its fair-access rules expect a declared User-Agent. `bin/sentinel connect test` checks the connector.
sources.holds: Company filings and structured financial data.

sources.name: Ad library connector
sources.note: Listed from the connector roster only; this library does not describe it further.

sources.name: FARA eFile API
sources.publisher: U.S. Department of Justice, FARA Unit
sources.holds: Registrants, foreign principals, short forms, and filed documents including informational materials.
sources.cannot_show: A registration is a statement of a relationship; it does not show the effect of the work.

sources.name: Federal grants connector
sources.note: Listed from the connector roster only; this library does not describe it further.

sources.name: Congress.gov API v3

key.how: Sign up at https://api.congress.gov/sign-up/ . The README points to api.data.gov for key guidance, so an existing api.data.gov key may already work.

sources.limits: 5,000 requests an hour. 20 results per page by default, up to 250.
sources.holds: Bills and amendments with their actions and dates, members, and other congressional records (the README documents the bill and amendment endpoints; the rest are in its Documentation folder).
sources.cannot_show: Why anyone acted. It turns the bill numbers on lobbying filings into dated actions for the timeline; it does not connect the two.
sources.first_use_why: Lists the bills that appear in more than one lobbying filing: the short list worth looking up on Congress.gov first.

verified.found: v3; key required; 5,000 requests/hour; up to 250 results per page.

sources.name: GovInfo API

key.how: api.data.gov key (DEMO_KEY works for testing at reduced limits).

sources.limits: Default 36,000 requests an hour, 1,200 a minute, 40 a second.
sources.holds: Official published text by collection: BILLS, CHRG (hearings), CREC (Congressional Record), CRPT (reports), FR, CFR, PLAW (laws), CDIR.
sources.cannot_show: Anything GPO has not published. Hearing transcripts arrive on GPO's schedule, often well after the hearing.

verified.found: api.data.gov key; 36,000/hour, 1,200/minute, 40/second; collection codes as listed.

sources.note: api.govinfo.gov answered robots.txt with HTTP 500 on 2026-09-30. Under RFC 9309 that means stay off the host, so the check probes the API page on www.govinfo.gov instead.

sources.name: OFAC Sanctions List Service
sources.publisher: U.S. Department of the Treasury, Office of Foreign Assets Control

key.how: The service page states no key or registration.

sources.holds: The SDN list and the consolidated non-SDN lists, with an archive of change files.
sources.cannot_show: That anyone absent from the list is clean. Match on identifiers, not names. This is the primary record behind US rows in SRC-OPENSANCTIONS.
sources.first_use_why: Captures the list page into evidence with a hash, so later designations can be compared against a dated copy.

verified.found: Host and paths as listed; the page offers the SDN list, consolidated lists, a customization tool and a change archive.

sources.name: DOJ API v1 (press releases, blog entries)
sources.publisher: U.S. Department of Justice, Office of Public Affairs

key.how: The v1 documentation mentions no key.

sources.limits: The documentation warns that more than 4 requests a second may be degraded or blocked. pagesize up to 50.
sources.holds: The Department's own announcements of charges, pleas, sentences and settlements, with dates.
sources.cannot_show: Guilt. A release is the Department's statement (OFFICIAL_ATTRIBUTION); a charge is an allegation until a court decides. Private defendants are counted, never named.

verified.found: Endpoints, pagesize up to 50, and the more-than-4-requests-a-second warning, as documented. The endpoint answered 200 from a script once, then 401 on repeat calls from the same shared address.

sources.note: From a shared cloud address on 2026-09-30 the press-release endpoint answered 200 once, then 401 block pages on repeat calls. BLOCKED in a check means try later or open it in a browser. Keep well under the documented 4 requests a second.

sources.name: Federal Audit Clearinghouse API

key.how: api.data.gov key, sent as the X-Api-Key header.

sources.limits: DEMO_KEY: 30 requests an hour and 50 a day per IP. Personal keys are higher. Production data updates weekly, usually Wednesdays.
sources.holds: Single audits of organizations that spend federal awards. The getting-started page documents /general; the other tables are in the FAC data dictionary.
sources.cannot_show: Organizations below the single-audit threshold. An audit finding is the auditor's statement, not a legal finding.

verified.found: api.fac.gov; X-Api-Key header; DEMO_KEY limits; weekly production updates.

sources.name: SAM.gov Exclusions API v4

key.how: Key from a SAM.gov account (Account Details) or a system account.

sources.limits: 10 requests a day for a non-federal personal key with no role; 1,000 a day with a role or a non-federal system account. Spend them only on award recipients already in a finding.
sources.holds: Exclusions (debarments and suspensions): excluding agency, exclusion type, dates, and UEI/CAGE for entities.
sources.cannot_show: Absence is not good standing. Results include individuals: count them, never name them.

verified.found: v4 endpoint; key types and daily limits as listed.

sources.name: IRS Exempt Organizations Business Master File extract
sources.holds: The registry of tax-exempt organizations by EIN: name, location, subsection, ruling date and filing codes. Page updated 2026-09-08, 1,964,958 records.
sources.cannot_show: Donors, grants, or who controls an organization.
sources.first_use_why: A dated, hashed copy of Ohio's exempt-organization registry, so an EIN on a filing can be checked offline.

verified.found: CSV per state and region; URL pattern; last updated 2026-09-08.

sources.name: Wayback Machine availability and CDX APIs
sources.note: The availability endpoint rate-limited a shared script address (HTTP 429) on 2026-09-30. Space requests out.
sources.holds: Archived snapshots of public pages, with capture times.
sources.cannot_show: That a page never existed or never changed. An archived copy is a second custody record, not the original.
sources.use_when: verify-sources reports a cited URL changed or gone.

verified.found: Availability endpoint and parameters; CDX documentation lives on GitHub.

sources.name: Ohio Secretary of State campaign finance data portal
sources.note: A JavaScript app; it answered a script with 403 on 2026-09-30. Its files and formats were NOT confirmed. Open it in a browser.
sources.holds: State-level campaign finance data (contents unconfirmed).

verified.via: web search result for the portal URL
verified.found: The portal exists; contents not readable without a browser.

sources.name: PUCO Docketing Information System
sources.note: No public API found. Search in a browser, then capture the filings you choose with bin/sentinel doc get.
sources.holds: Utility case dockets: applications, testimony, entries and orders.
sources.cannot_show: What was decided off the record. A filing is a party's position.

verified.found: DIS search pages; answered 200 from a script.

sources.name: ODNR oil and gas wells (GIS open data, RBDMS reports)
sources.note: Both pages answered 200 on 2026-09-30, but they are JavaScript apps: fields, formats and update dates were NOT confirmed.
sources.holds: Locations of known oil and gas well activity in Ohio (per the dataset's description).

sources.name: Open States API v3

key.how: Register at open.pluralpolicy.com; send as the X-API-KEY header or ?apikey=.

sources.note: The overview page does not state rate limits.
sources.holds: State bills, legislators, committees and events, aggregated from the legislatures.
sources.cannot_show: It is a copy. Confirm each item on the legislature's own site before it enters the ledger.

verified.found: Base URL, key header, endpoint families.

sources.name: USDC contract addresses (issuer page)
sources.holds: The issuer's own list of USDC contracts by network.
sources.cannot_show: Anything about who holds or moves the tokens.
sources.kit_check: Read on 2026-09-30: Ethereum 0xA0b86991c6218b36c1d19D4a2e9Eb0cE3606eB48 and Base 0x833589fCD6eDb6E08f4c7C32D4f71b54bdA02913 are listed exactly as the coin module has them. Record your own reading with bin/sentinel-coin token verify.

verified.found: Ethereum and Base addresses match the coin module character for character.

sources.name: Tether supported protocols (issuer page)
sources.holds: The issuer's list of supported networks and contract addresses, and the networks it no longer supports.
sources.cannot_show: Anything about who holds or moves the tokens.
sources.kit_check: Read on 2026-09-30: the Ethereum address is listed in lowercase, 0xdac17f958d2ee523a2206206994597c13d831ec7. It is the same address the coin module holds in EIP-55 form (capitalization is only a checksum). The page also says Tether no longer issues or redeems on Kusama, Bitcoin Cash SLP, Omni, EOS and Algorand.

sources.name: mempool.space REST API
sources.limits: Rate-limited: over the limit returns HTTP 429, and repeated excess can get a client banned. No numbers published on the docs page.
sources.holds: Raw transactions, merkle proofs and block headers: what V1/V2 verification needs, from an index you do not run.
sources.cannot_show: Who controls an address. Trust it for availability, never for truth: the bytes are proven locally.
sources.use_when: As a second index for V3, if bin/sentinel-coin sources shows its REST client expects these paths.
